nodes.n: Semi-final morning. A team meeting nobody called. Kunal stands at the front with a laptop. Harsh Malhotra sits in the corner. So does Rajan Sethi.

nodes.t: Gentlemen, before we talk tactics, let's talk loyalty.

nodes.n: On the screen: the Gate 4 photo. Then the balcony and the ladder, from a security camera. Then a close-up of a henna palm with your initial.

nodes.t: Our rookie has been sneaking into the owner's house. With the owner's daughter. During the owner's daughter's engagement. To me.
Suspended. Effective now. You don't play the semi-final. You don't play the final. You don't set foot in this stadium.

choice.t: "Ask him what happens to your team after the wedding."
choice.d: Say it in front of everyone.

nodes.t: Wow. Now he's inventing conspiracies. Sir, this is exactly the kind of character we don't need.

nodes.n: You walk out of the stadium carrying your kit bag. Fans who chanted your name two weeks ago take photos of you leaving.

msgs.t: They took her phone. The real one AND the old one.
She's not allowed out of the house till the wedding.

nodes.n: Evening. A black car stops beside you on the street. The window rolls down. Gold spectacles.

nodes.t: Get in, Sonpur. Don't argue. I stole the car.

nodes.n: She presses a small silver pen drive into your hand.

nodes.t: My granddaughter recorded the Sethis. In our own dining room, last night. She's braver than both of you put together.

nodes.cliff: Meera got the proof. Now someone has to get it to her father.
